tooltip.tp_dragon_heart.dragons_heart_fi: Grants the Fire Dragon Blessing effect (ignites and knocks back targets)
When wearing the 'Fire Dragon Eye' at the same time, it gives an effect of+1 level
When wearing the 'Dragon Fire' or 'Scary Steel Armor' at the same time, grant an effect of+1 level
tooltip.tp_dragon_heart.dragons_heart_ic: Grants the Ice Dragon Blessing effect (slows and freezes targets)
When wearing the 'Ice Dragon Eye' at the same time, it gives an effect of+1 level
When wearing the 'Dragon Ice' or 'Scary Steel Armor' at the same time, grant an effect of+1 level
tooltip.tp_dragon_heart.dragons_heart_li: Grants the Lightning Dragon Protection effect (shocks and paralyzes targets)
Attacks all entities except the attacker
When wearing the 'Lightning Dragon Eye' at the same time, it gives an effect of+1 level
When wearing the 'Dragon Lightning' or 'Scary Steel Armor' at the same time, grant an effect of+1 level
Basic damage+6 (up to 3 levels as the level increases)
The type of damage depends on the type of damage inflicted by the attacker
advancements.tp_dragon_heart.dragon_hear: Obtain any of the three Dragon's Hearts and make it beat again
Collect the Fire, Ice and Lightning Dragon's Hearts
